questions.question: Resolve Desargues’s birth date: the article gives 21 February 1591, as in the Dictionary of Scientific Biography (https://mathshistory.st-andrews.ac.uk/DSB/Desargues.pdf), whereas the current MacTutor biography, citing René Taton’s 1962 research, gives 2 March 1591 (https://mathshistory.st-andrews.ac.uk/Biographies/Desargues/). Select a date or briefly acknowledge the discrepancy in both editions.

localizations.source: Resolve Desargues’s birth date: the article gives 21 February 1591, as in the Dictionary of Scientific Biography (https://mathshistory.st-andrews.ac.uk/DSB/Desargues.pdf), whereas the current MacTutor biography, citing René Taton’s 1962 research, gives 2 March 1591 (https://mathshistory.st-andrews.ac.uk/Biographies/Desargues/). Select a date or briefly acknowledge the discrepancy in both editions.
localizations.ru: Согласовать дату рождения Дезарга: статья даёт 21 февраля 1591 года, как в Dictionary of Scientific Biography (https://mathshistory.st-andrews.ac.uk/DSB/Desargues.pdf), тогда как современная биография MacTutor со ссылкой на исследование Рене Татона 1962 года указывает 2 марта 1591 года (https://mathshistory.st-andrews.ac.uk/Biographies/Desargues/). Выбрать дату либо кратко оговорить расхождение в RU/EN.

questions.resolution: MacTutor confirms 21 February 1591 as the birth date and 2 March as the baptism date; the article text remains unchanged.

questions.question: For fig-1 and fig-2, credit the artwork to Théobald Chartran and identify the 1886–1889 Sorbonne mural depicting the supposed 1643 scene; retain William Sidnam’s photographer credit, add the authoritative source https://nubis.bis-sorbonne.fr/web/expo/s/le-discours-de-la-methode/page/74_genese-et-contexte.html, and establish a licence or permission for the exact photographic bytes being published.
